name: header-printf-g
description: The World Editor passes the custom script header (only it) through C printf with no arguments (target/evidence/verify-2026-11-22/wb.md): hp-g.w3x (tests/fixtures/we-specs/make-header-printf.mjs: %%, %*, 100%, %%%, %%%%, %%*, %*%, %%d, a%%b%%c, %%%*%%, %**, %%%%%*, x%, %%%%%% and a comment '100%% and %* and 5%' in header.j), the editor opens and saves it; Studio generates the script (lib/script/printf.ts headerPrintf)

name: header-printf-new
description: header-printf-g with the rest of printf's grammar before a char that is no conversion (hp-new.w3x): width (%5%, %*5, %1$), precision (%.3, %.*, %.5.), length modifiers (%hh, %I64, %I3, %I32, %w, %T, %L, %j, %t, %ll; %lz and %N crash the save, so they aren't in it), flags (%-, %0, %#, %+, '% ', %'), other chars (%q, %!, %$, %b, %D, %v, %k, %r)

name: header-printf-end1
description: A header whose very last char is a lone % ('// end x%', no line break after it: hp-end1.w3x)

name: header-printf-end2
description: A header that ends in a % and a width ('// end y%5', no line break after it: hp-end2.w3x)

name: header-printf-lua
description: header-printf-g's cases in a Lua map's header.lua (hp-lua.w3x): war3map.lua

name: header-printf-lua-mod
description: A Lua header using % as Lua's modulo operator (tostring(7 % 3): hp-lua-mod.w3x): war3map.lua
